description: Release a task you have claimed back to the queue without completing it. Use when you cannot finish the work or another agent should take over — the task returns to open status and becomes immediately claimable. Leave a `handoff` note so the next agent resumes instead of restarting. Hosted API only.

handoff.description: Optional handoff note: where you left off / why you stopped (e.g. 'migration written, blocked on prod DB creds'). The next agent to claim this task sees it as a 'Resuming from' line. If omitted, the task's last session-state detail is preserved as the note.

task_id.description: The claimed task ID to release

name: release_task
